scoring_justification: The binding energies are produced by expensive DFT/AIMD calculations impossible to recompute in the checker. Comparing reported values to paper gold with tolerances is the only feasible verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden reference binding energies and tolerances for the four water layers
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper main text, Fig.4 and associated methods: LiV first -0.89±0.02, KV first -0.69±0.09, LiV second -0.7±0.5, KV second -0.6±0.5 eV/H2O.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the paper's reported DFT binding energies.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values reported in the paper and used by the reference solver solve.sh. They are the authoritative comparison for this reproduction task.

outputs.description: Average water binding energy per water molecule (in eV) for the first and second contact layers of Li-vermiculite and K-vermiculite surfaces, computed from DFT geometry optimizations on snapshots from AIMD simulations.

output_contract.notes: Binding energies are used to explain the observed difference in hydrophilicity between LiV and KV. The values are to be compared against the paper-reported values within hidden tolerances.
